items.title: File Einspruch against the Kfz-Steuer assessment
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat; sie beginnt mit der Bekanntgabe, die bei einfachem Brief am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden als erfolgt gilt.
items.computation: Document date (and earliest possible posting day) is Wed 22.10.2025. Deemed delivery under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO is the 4th day after posting: 26.10.2025, which is a Sunday, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO it shifts to the next working day, Mon 27.10.2025. The one-month Einspruchsfrist (§ 355 AO) starts the day after (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later on the day with the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Thu 27.11.2025. That day is a working day (no NRW/nationwide holiday), so it stays as the deadline.

warnings: The new annual tax amount of 238,00 € is collected automatically by direct debit (Lastschrift) as before, so no separate payment action or due date applies for the person; only double-check the next bank statement to confirm the correct amount is taken.

The letter and sender address use a placeholder/fictitious town name (Beispielstein, PLZ 49090) and a 'Musterausgabe' label, consistent with this being a sample/template document rather than a letter from a real Hauptzollamt — verify authenticity if this was actually received as real correspondence.
